claims.verbatim:
Steamship Caledonia (Br.), Ferrier, Glasgow 7th inst., via London-
derry 9th inst., with mdse. and pass. to F. McDonald & Co. Sept.
24, off George's Shoals, passed steamship Scotland, bound E.; same
day, 60 miles E. of Nantucket, passed an Inman steamship bound east.
